sprints.theme: Codex compatibility and typed knowledge artifacts

items.why_now: Instruction and skill drift can invalidate every later execution; fix the context substrate first.
items.done_when: Cross-agent entrypoints, target-path doctor and black-box fixtures prove the effective instruction/skill chain.

items.why_now: Physics migration work needs research-before and evidence-after artifacts without fake progress percentages.
items.done_when: Plan/research/evidence schema, MCP, audit and SPA facets land with provenance and migration tests.

items.why_now: Provider model-family names are embedded in persisted state and must be replaced before orchestration hardening.
items.done_when: A provider-neutral capability schema, legacy migration and runtime matcher pass compatibility and risk-escalation tests.

items.why_now: First-class plan, research and evidence types need matching filesystem roots and stable typed identity.
items.done_when: Typed directories, routing and an idempotent mixed-layout migration pass server, MCP, SPA and static-build tests.

items.why_now: The required project index is a version-contention and payload monolith; split it only after typed roots exist.
items.done_when: Separate sprint and project-state resources replace the index with parity, rollback and concurrency evidence.

items.why_now: Portable builds are verified locally; closure waits on distributed sprint state and an explicit distribution name.
items.done_when: Validation-only CI is retained, automatic publishing is removed, project-state migration lands, and the local distribution name is resolved.

items.why_now: Readable MCP responses should target the final typed and distributed resource model rather than reformat the monolith twice.
items.done_when: Layered summary/detail/raw resource responses are smaller, clearer and backwards-compatible.

sprints.theme: Current orchestration, lifecycle and evidence residue

items.why_now: Merge-time validation, truthful promotion state and shared worktree provisioning remain current orchestration gaps.
items.done_when: The remaining focused followups land with interruption, content-survival and provisioning evidence.

items.why_now: The audit groundwork exists, but write and close policy still needs one explicit strictness decision.
items.done_when: The strictness choice is locked and the remaining lifecycle mechanisms are implemented to that choice.

items.why_now: One fresh portfolio sweep and its gate evidence are the only remaining derived-state work.
items.done_when: A current census drives the sweep, the evidence requirement is amended, and sweep-complete passes.

items.why_now: The render fault is known; the user-visible fallback and browser-free regression are still absent.
items.done_when: The surface degrades legibly and a browser-free test catches the diagnosed render failure.

items.why_now: Section anchors work, but foreign terminal followups remain unaudited and transition edges remain undecided.
items.done_when: The foreign-terminal audit lands and the transition-edge design is decided before its implementation proceeds.

items.why_now: The configuration check landed, while snapshot detection still needs a mechanism that respects legitimate exact assertions.
items.done_when: The mechanism decision is locked and its bound check covers both frozen snapshots and object substitution without false positives.

items.why_now: The mechanism landed, but this plan still lacks the synthesis its own terminal guard requires.
items.done_when: A plan-evidence-for synthesis is written from plan comments and the committed run ledger, then terminal closure succeeds.

items.why_now: Four captures are complete; two remain behind a real host or browser Network Service repair.
items.done_when: A replacement passes both data and HTTP navigation controls and the two owed captures are recorded.
